title: Yehudah ben Patora
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He and Elazar ben Patora were wicked men in the time of Yochanan the High Priest who seized terumah by force, as related at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni. In Kiddushin 66a,
Elazar is mentioned disparagingly under the name Elazar ben Poira instead of Patora.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:5 tells of coercive taking in a passage about the distribution of tithes. It names Elazar ben Pechorah and Yehudah ben Petirah. Kiddushin 66a names Elazar ben Poira in the Yannai narrative. The translation retains Hyman’s Patora spellings and his designation terumah.
